_doc: The campaign (owner: 'a city map of districts held by enemies; story missions push in; contracts in reached districts; the city recovers visibly'). districts: grid x,y on the city map (3×3), held = who holds it at the start (swarm | army | both), story = the story mission that frees it, after = story missions that must be done first, tier = loot tier of its contracts. A district is REACHED once it borders a freed district (or is the start). contracts: templates the board fills from (js/sim/campaign.js). licences: reputation with each maker (from their contracts) unlocks their parts at the dealer and a discount.

city.name: Larkspur
city.blurb: A coastal megacity of glass towers and refinery flats. Half of it went dark when the swarm broke through the sea wall; the rest is being carved up by Halden-Voss Security, a company army that calls it 'stabilisation'.

contracts.name: Clear-out
contracts.brief: {client} wants {district} swept clean before their crews go back in. Clear every contact.

contracts.name: Nest burn
contracts.brief: Hives have taken root in {district}. Burn every one before they bud.

contracts.name: Demolition
contracts.brief: {client} is writing off {count} buildings in {district} that the enemy turned into strongpoints. Bring them down.

contracts.name: Hold
contracts.brief: {client} is pulling people out of {district}. Hold the area until the last transport is gone.

contracts.name: Hunt
contracts.brief: A big one is roaming {district}. {client} will pay for its head. The rest are a bonus.

contracts.name: Sabotage
contracts.brief: Halden-Voss has relay masts in {district}. Plant charges on {count} of them — stand at each for a few seconds.

contracts.name: Recovery
contracts.brief: A data core went down with a {client} transport in {district}. Find it, carry it to the dropship.

contracts.name: Convoy raid
contracts.brief: A Halden-Voss convoy is crossing {district}. Stop at least {count} trucks before they reach the far side.

contracts.name: Escort
contracts.brief: A {client} supply convoy has to cross {district}. Keep the trucks alive until they're through.

licences.text: Fly contracts for a maker to earn its trust. Each licence puts more of that maker's parts on the dealer's shelves — including ones above your rank — and takes money off them.
